task_description: Write a method in Dafny to find the median length of a trapezium.
specification_response:
Method Signature:
    method MedianLengthOfTrapezium(a: array<real>) returns (median: real)
Postconditions_prompt:
    - The returned value is the median length of the trapezium sides based on the input array
    - The median is correctly computed as the middle value when the array is sorted, or the average of the two middle values if the array length is even
